sourceFile: 10. MSU-L20S15-07 DT Report test Plasma suspension A,B to improve NG solder weak - 2025.5.14_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures a plasma-vs-normal spot-welding test but misgroups SUS type as a changed condition and uses an invalid outcome metric label.
issues: Changed condition incorrectly includes SUS B instead of treating SUS A/B as subgroups.
Baseline/test mapping is ambiguous for SUS B due merged or omitted content rows.
Outcome metric is a section title, not NG rate or spot-welding defect result.
Full cited texts for key test rows 17 and 19 are absent from the provided context.
Bonding solder pad condition may be a secondary condition or confound for SUS B baseline.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to plasma suspension use versus normal process.
Keep SUS A and SUS B as subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Confirm full row 17 and row 19 values including merged content/date fields.
Define outcomes as input, OK, weak solder, offset, total NG, and NG rate.
Record bonding solder pad as a secondary condition for the SUS B normal baseline if applicable.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient until key comparison rows and headers are fully exposed and grouped.
